common.noPayment: No payment is taken anywhere in this prototype.

validation.required: This is needed before we can deliver.
validation.tooLong: Please keep this to {{max}} characters or fewer.
validation.countryCode: Use the two-letter country code, for example AE.

warnings.title: Worth knowing
warnings.unknown: The kitchen sent a note we do not recognise yet ({{code}}). Nothing is wrong with your order; please mention it if you contact us.
warnings.checkout_empty_cart: There is nothing in the basket to price.
warnings.planner_allergen_conflict: Something in this basket declares an allergen you have asked us to exclude. Please check every dish before ordering.
warnings.subscription_no_delivery_days: No delivery days have been chosen, so this subscription would never deliver.
warnings.subscription_delivery_day_unavailable: This plan does not deliver on one of the days you chose.
warnings.subscription_unknown_slot: That delivery window is not one this kitchen offers.

address.label: Name for this address
address.labelHint: Home, office, or whatever you will recognise.
address.line1Hint: Building, street and apartment or villa number.
address.line2Hint: Optional. A landmark, a floor, a compound name.
address.areaHint: The neighbourhood the kitchen delivers to, for example Business Bay.
address.cityHint: The city this address is in.
address.countryCodeHint: Two letters, for example AE for the United Arab Emirates.
address.instructionsHint: Optional. Anything the rider needs to know to find you.
address.notStored: This address is used for this order only. Nothing is saved to your account, because this prototype has no address book yet.

cart.title: Your basket
cart.body: Individual meals from the marketplace. Subscriptions are set up separately and do not pass through here.
cart.emptyBody: Add a meal from the marketplace and it will appear here with its price.
cart.deliveryAtPlacement: Confirmed when the order is placed.
cart.summaryEmpty: There is nothing to price yet.
cart.priceCaption: Priced by the kitchen. Nothing is reserved and nothing is charged.
cart.updateFailedTitle: That change did not go through
cart.allergenBody: Something here declares an allergen your profile asks us to exclude. Open each meal and read its allergen list.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.body: Choose a saved address and a delivery window, then place the order. Payment is cash on delivery.
checkout.emptyTitle: There is nothing to check out
checkout.emptyBody: Your basket is empty, so there is nothing to price or deliver.
checkout.addressBody: Delivery is priced from a saved address in your account, so the kitchen can resolve the zone.
checkout.noAddressBody: Checkout needs a saved address so we can match a delivery zone and fee.
checkout.dateHint: The earliest is tomorrow: today's cooking has already started.
checkout.earliest: The earliest the kitchen can deliver this basket is {{date}}.
checkout.priceBeforeReview: Basket subtotal. Delivery fee is confirmed when the order is placed.
checkout.priceAfterReview: Ready to place. Delivery fee is confirmed with the kitchen at placement.
checkout.placeOrderHint: Cash on delivery or card sandbox after placement. Card details are never entered here.
checkout.paymentNoticeBody: Cash on delivery is available for every order. Card payments use the sandbox provider after you place the order — we never store card numbers.
checkout.placeFailedTitle: The order could not be placed
checkout.successBody: Your order reference is {{reference}}. The kitchen has been notified.
checkout.successCodBody: No payment was taken in the app. Pay the driver when the order arrives.
checkout.successPriceCaption: Basket total shown at checkout. Delivery may adjust at confirmation.

configurator.title: Set up your subscription
configurator.body: Eight short steps. We check delivery and allergies before we show you a price.
configurator.priceLater: You will see the full price at step seven, after we have checked that we can deliver to you and what we need to leave out.
configurator.notFoundTitle: We could not find that plan
configurator.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date. Browse the plans and pick one to configure.
configurator.createFailedTitle: We could not start this subscription
configurator.previewEmptyBody: Go back a step and check the start date and the delivery days.
configurator.disclaimerContext: Calorie bands and macro ranges describe a rotating menu, not a measured meal.
configurator.allergyDisclaimerContext: Allergen exclusions here are a kitchen instruction, not a medical assessment.

issues.variant: Choose a calorie band to continue.
issues.duration: Choose how long the subscription should run.
issues.startWeekday: This plan does not deliver on that weekday.
issues.noDeliveryDays: Choose at least one delivery day.
issues.deliveryDayUnavailable: One of the days you chose is not a delivery day for this plan.
issues.areaUnserved: This kitchen does not deliver to that area, so this subscription cannot go ahead.
issues.checks: Confirm the delivery and allergen checks before we price this.
issues.terms: Confirm the summary before starting the subscription.

plan.macroCaveat: These are ranges across a rotating menu, not a figure for a single meal. Any given day lands somewhere inside them.

combination.body: How many meals a day, and how many snacks with them.
combination.label: Meals and snacks
combination.couplingTitle: Changing this can move your calorie band
combination.couplingBody: In this catalogue the meal combination and the calorie band belong to the same plan option, so choosing a different combination may also change the band. We would rather tell you than move the number quietly.

duration.body: Longer commitments earn a bigger discount. You can pause or skip days on any of them.
duration.caveat: These totals are worked out from the weekly price. The kitchen prices the subscription itself at the summary step, and that figure is the one that counts.

dietary.dietsBody: The profiles this plan can cook to. Choosing none means the standard rotation.
dietary.allergensBody: Pre-filled from the allergies on your profile. The list shows what this kitchen declares on its own menu.
dietary.allergensLoading: Reading the allergies on your profile...
dietary.allergensNone: This kitchen declares no allergens on the menu we can see, and your profile records none.
dietary.relaxedBody: Your profile records an allergy to {{allergens}} and this subscription would no longer exclude it. Meals containing it could be delivered. Please only do this if you are certain.
dietary.addedBody: This subscription will also exclude {{allergens}}, on top of what your profile records.

delivery.startHint: The earliest is tomorrow, and it has to be a day this plan delivers on.
delivery.weekdaysBody: Choose the days you want food to arrive. Days this plan does not deliver on cannot be chosen.
delivery.weekdaysLoading: Checking which days this plan delivers on...

checks.title: Two checks before we show a price
checks.body: Whether we can deliver to you, and what we must leave out. Both are cheap to ask and both decide whether this subscription can work at all, so they come first.
checks.relaxedTitle: An allergy from your profile is not being excluded
checks.relaxedBody: {{allergens}} will not be filtered out of your deliveries. Go back a step if that is not what you meant.
checks.acknowledgeLabel: I have read the delivery and allergen checks above.
checks.acknowledgeDescription: We record this so it is clear the checks were seen before any price was shown.
checks.areaServedBody: This kitchen publishes a delivery zone covering {{area}}.
checks.areaUnservedTitle: This kitchen does not deliver to that area
checks.areaUnservedBody: We cannot deliver to {{area}}. This kitchen currently publishes zones for {{areas}}. Change the area, or choose a plan from another kitchen.
checks.areaUnknownTitle: We cannot confirm your area yet
checks.areaUnknownBody: This kitchen has not published its delivery zones, so we cannot check the address from here. Enter the area and we will confirm before the first delivery.

meals.body: A sample of your first week, drawn from this plan's own menu. You can swap any day.
meals.noDates: Choose a start date and some delivery days first, and your first week will appear here.
meals.unknown: To be chosen by the kitchen
meals.noteSwappable: Swaps are recorded with the subscription. The kitchen rotates its menu, so later weeks will differ.
meals.noteStatic: We could not load this kitchen's full menu, so this is the plan's published sample and cannot be swapped here.

summary.checksTitle: Delivery and allergen checks are done
summary.checksBody: You confirmed both before this price was worked out, which is the point of asking them early.
summary.priceCaption: Worked out by the kitchen from the configuration above. It reserves nothing and charges nothing.

confirm.title: Ready to start
confirm.body: One last look. Nothing is charged, and you can pause, skip a day or change the address afterwards.
confirm.termsBody: The subscription is created immediately and appears in your subscriptions. No payment is taken now and none is taken later: this prototype has no payment step at all.
confirm.acknowledgeLabel: I have read the summary and want to start this subscription.
confirm.acknowledgeDescription: Recorded so it is clear the summary was seen before the subscription was created.

configurator.successNoPayment: No payment was taken. This prototype has no payment step.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.body: Meal plans that deliver on a schedule. Pause, skip a day or change the address at any time.
subscriptions.emptyBody: A meal plan delivers on a schedule you choose, with a discount for longer commitments.
subscriptions.emptyFilteredBody: No subscription is in that state at the moment.
subscriptions.newHint: New subscriptions start from a meal plan: open a plan and choose Configure subscription.

subscription.notFoundTitle: We could not find that subscription
subscription.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the subscription may belong to another account.
subscription.configCaption: The delivery configuration of this subscription
subscription.timelineNote: This is what the subscription record holds today. There is no event history behind it yet, so we do not claim to know when each change happened.

readOnly.draft: This subscription has not started yet.
readOnly.cancelled: It was cancelled, so nothing can be changed. Start a new subscription from any meal plan.
readOnly.expired: It has run its full length, so nothing can be changed. Start a new subscription from any meal plan.

subscription.actionsNote: Every action here changes the subscription immediately. No payment is involved in any of them.
subscription.skipSheetBody: Your next few delivery days. Skipping one leaves the rest of the schedule alone.
subscription.pauseDialogBody: Deliveries stop until you resume. Nothing is cancelled and nothing is lost.
subscription.pauseUntilHint: Optional. Leave this empty to pause until you resume it yourself.
subscription.pauseConsequenceOpen: No delivery will be scheduled until you press Resume. We will not choose a date for you.
subscription.pauseConsequenceUntil: We will record {{date}} as the day you intend to resume. You still press Resume yourself, so nothing restarts without you.
subscription.resumeDialogBody: Deliveries start again on the next day this plan delivers on.
subscription.skipDialogDated: The delivery on {{date}} will not be made.
subscription.skipConsequenceBody: That day is removed from the schedule and the following delivery day becomes your next one. The rest of the subscription is untouched.
subscription.addressDialogBody: The new address applies from the next delivery onwards.
subscription.slotDialogBody: Pick a new window, and adjust the delivery days if you want to.
subscription.slotDaysNote: Leave these as they are to keep the current schedule. Days this plan does not deliver on will be refused by the kitchen.

balance.title: Your balance
balance.perDay: per delivery day, at the price you paid
balance.skipped_one: 1 skipped day, which cost you nothing
balance.skipped_other: {{count}} skipped days, which cost you nothing
balance.cutOffNote_one: Changes apply to deliveries more than 1 hour away. Anything sooner goes as planned.
balance.cutOffNote_other: Changes apply to deliveries more than {{count}} hours away. Anything sooner goes as planned.

deliveries.title: Delivery history
deliveries.caption: Every delivery day on this subscription and what became of it
deliveries.empty: No delivery days have been planned yet.
deliveries.skipNote: Skipped days cost nothing. Your balance simply stretches further into the future.

cancel.title: Cancel this subscription?
cancel.body: Deliveries stop after the change cut-off. This cannot be undone.
cancel.consequenceBody_one: Your 1 remaining delivery day will not be delivered.
cancel.consequenceBody_other: Your {{count}} remaining delivery days will not be delivered.
cancel.estimate_one: We will record a credit of {{amount}} — 1 unused day at {{perDay}}.
cancel.estimate_other: We will record a credit of {{amount}} — {{count}} unused days at {{perDay}}.
cancel.noRefund: There is no unused balance left, so nothing will be credited.
cancel.manualSettlement: A credit is recorded against your account and settled by hand. No money moves automatically.
cancel.doneMemo_one: A credit of {{amount}} has been recorded for 1 unused day.
cancel.doneMemo_other: A credit of {{amount}} has been recorded for {{count}} unused days.
cancel.doneNoMemo: There was no unused balance, so nothing was credited.

weekdays.title: Which days do you want deliveries?
weekdays.body: Only the days this plan delivers on are offered.
weekdays.loading: Checking which days this plan delivers on…
weekdays.chooseOne: Choose at least one delivery day.
weekdays.cutOffBody_one: Deliveries less than 1 hour away go ahead as planned. The change starts after that.
weekdays.cutOffBody_other: Deliveries less than {{count}} hours away go ahead as planned. The change starts after that.

choices.title: Choose the meal for this delivery
choices.body: Pick what you would like on your next delivery day.
choices.bodyDated: Pick what you would like delivered on {{date}}.
choices.cutOffBody: Choices close before the delivery is prepared. After that the kitchen cooks its default for that day.

sources.kitchen_default: The kitchen will cook {{meal}} unless you choose something else.
sources.substituted: {{meal}} was substituted, within your allergen declarations.
